spec.description: NASA's Deep Space Network live: its fifteen antennas at Goldstone, Madrid and Canberra in 3D over their satellite images, each turned to where it points now and coloured by what it is doing, from the DSN Now feed; the spacecraft each one talks to, the data coming down, and how long each signal takes to reach Earth.

spec.rawSql:
-- DSN Now's feed through the gateway (/dsn/dsn.xml, kept 5 s): one XML file with a <dish> for each antenna
-- at work, where it points, and inside it a <target> for each spacecraft with its <upSignal>s and <downSignal>s.
WITH feed AS (
  SELECT r->>'body' AS xml FROM (SELECT http_get('http://feeds/dsn/dsn.xml') AS r) WHERE (r->>'status') = '200'
),
craft AS (
  -- The spacecraft's full names (JWST: James Webb Space Telescope), from DSN Now's configuration (kept a day).
  SELECT upper(regexp_extract(s, ' name="([^"]*)"', 1)) AS code, regexp_extract(s, 'friendlyName="([^"]*)"', 1) AS craft
  FROM (SELECT unnest(regexp_extract_all(r->>'body', '<spacecraft [^>]*>')) AS s
        FROM (SELECT http_get('http://feeds/dsn/config.xml') AS r) WHERE (r->>'status') = '200')
),
dish AS (
  SELECT x, regexp_extract(x, '<dish [^>]*>') AS tag
  FROM (SELECT unnest(regexp_extract_all(xml, '(?s)<dish [^>]*>.*?</dish>')) AS x FROM feed)
),
live AS (
  SELECT regexp_extract(tag, ' name="([^"]*)"', 1) AS dish,
         TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(tag, 'azimuthAngle="([^"]*)"', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS azimuth,
         TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(tag, 'elevationAngle="([^"]*)"', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS elevation,
         TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(tag, 'windSpeed="([^"]*)"', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS wind,
         regexp_extract(tag, 'activity="([^"]*)"', 1) AS activity,
         -- DSN and DSS are the network itself (tests, maintenance), not a spacecraft.
         list_filter(regexp_extract_all(x, '<target name="([^"]*)"', 1), t -> t NOT IN ('DSN', 'DSS', '')) AS targets,
         list_max(list_transform(regexp_extract_all(x, '<downSignal [^>]*active="true"[^>]*dataRate="([^"]*)"', 1),
                                 v -> TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE))) AS down_bps,
         list_max(list_transform(regexp_extract_all(x, '<upSignal [^>]*active="true"[^>]*power="([^"]*)"', 1),
                                 v -> TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE))) AS up_kw,
         nullif(regexp_extract(x, '<downSignal [^>]*active="true"[^>]*band="([^"]*)"', 1), '') AS band,
         list_max(list_transform(regexp_extract_all(x, '<target [^>]*downlegRange="([^"]*)"', 1),
                                 v -> TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE))) AS range_km,
         list_max(list_transform(regexp_extract_all(x, '<target [^>]*rtlt="([^"]*)"', 1),
                                 v -> TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE))) AS rtlt_s
  FROM dish
),
dishes AS (
  -- Every antenna, those the feed leaves out (idle) too, and what it is doing now.
  SELECT d.*, l.azimuth, l.elevation, l.wind, l.activity, coalesce(l.targets, []) AS targets,
         l.down_bps, l.up_kw, l.band,
         CASE WHEN l.range_km > 0 THEN l.range_km END AS range_km,
         CASE WHEN l.rtlt_s > 0 THEN l.rtlt_s END AS rtlt_s,
         CASE WHEN len(coalesce(l.targets, [])) = 0 THEN 'Idle or in maintenance'
              WHEN l.up_kw IS NOT NULL AND l.down_bps IS NOT NULL THEN 'Two-way'
              WHEN l.down_bps IS NOT NULL THEN 'Receiving'
              WHEN l.up_kw IS NOT NULL THEN 'Transmitting'
              ELSE 'Pointing' END AS state
  FROM 'http://feeds/datasets/dsn-antennas/dishes.parquet' d LEFT JOIN live l USING (dish)
),
names AS (
  SELECT dish, string_agg(coalesce(c.craft, t), ', ') AS spacecraft
  FROM (SELECT dish, unnest(targets) AS t FROM dishes) LEFT JOIN craft c ON c.code = t
  GROUP BY dish
)
-- Spacecraft with a signal up or down on some antenna now.
SELECT count(DISTINCT t) AS spacecraft
FROM (SELECT unnest(targets) AS t FROM dishes WHERE state IN ('Two-way', 'Receiving', 'Transmitting'))

spec.description: Spacecraft with a signal going up or coming down on one of the fifteen antennas now (the network itself, in tests or maintenance, is left out).
spec.title: Spacecraft in contact

-- When DSN Now wrote the feed (its <timestamp>, epoch ms), through the gateway (kept 5 s).
SELECT epoch_ms(TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(r->>'body', '<timestamp>([0-9]+)</timestamp>', 1) AS BIGINT)) AS time
FROM (SELECT http_get('http://feeds/dsn/dsn.xml') AS r) WHERE (r->>'status') = '200'

spec.rawSql:
-- Server side: the recording of DSN Now (Pacha's recorder, feed dsn-now: every antenna every 30 s, kept a
-- week) over the time range, at most about 1,500 instants per antenna (one every 30 s for a day, every few
-- minutes for a week). Every antenna stands at every instant: one the feed left out was idle. With nothing
-- recorded in the range, each antenna stands once, idle, at its end.
SET VARIABLE dsn_step = greatest(30, (CAST(${__to} AS BIGINT) - CAST(${__from} AS BIGINT)) // 1500000);
WITH rec AS (
  SELECT * FROM read_parquet([${files:singlequote}], union_by_name = true)
  WHERE ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
),
craft AS (
  -- The spacecraft's full names (JWST: James Webb Space Telescope), from DSN Now's configuration (kept a day).
  SELECT upper(regexp_extract(s, ' name="([^"]*)"', 1)) AS code, regexp_extract(s, 'friendlyName="([^"]*)"', 1) AS craft
  FROM (SELECT unnest(regexp_extract_all(r->>'body', '<spacecraft [^>]*>')) AS s
        FROM (SELECT http_get('http://feeds/dsn/config.xml') AS r) WHERE (r->>'status') = '200')
),
names AS (
  SELECT t AS targets, string_agg(coalesce(c.craft, u.code), ', ') AS spacecraft
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT targets AS t FROM rec WHERE targets <> ''), unnest(string_split(t, ',')) AS u(code)
  LEFT JOIN craft c ON c.code = u.code
  GROUP BY t
),
steps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT time_bucket(to_seconds(getvariable('dsn_step')), ts) AS time FROM rec
  UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMPTZ WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rec)
),
last AS (
  -- Each antenna's last reading in each instant's step.
  SELECT time_bucket(to_seconds(getvariable('dsn_step')), ts) AS time, * EXCLUDE (ts)
  FROM rec
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY hex, time_bucket(to_seconds(getvariable('dsn_step')), ts) ORDER BY ts DESC) = 1
),
grid AS (
  SELECT s.time, d.*, l.azimuth, l.elevation, l.activity, coalesce(l.targets, '') AS targets,
         l.down_bps, l.up_kw, l.range_km,
         CASE WHEN coalesce(l.targets, '') = '' THEN 'Idle or in maintenance'
              WHEN l.up_kw IS NOT NULL AND l.down_bps IS NOT NULL THEN 'Two-way'
              WHEN l.down_bps IS NOT NULL THEN 'Receiving'
              WHEN l.up_kw IS NOT NULL THEN 'Transmitting'
              ELSE 'Pointing' END AS state
  FROM steps s CROSS JOIN 'http://feeds/datasets/dsn-antennas/dishes.parquet' d LEFT JOIN last l ON l.hex = d.dish AND l.time = s.time
)
-- Two parts of each antenna in the model (cdscc.glb), at every instant: its alidade turns to the azimuth
-- (model_yaw, degrees clockwise from north), its elevation wheel tilts the dish down from the zenith
-- (model_pitch); both in the colour of what the antenna is doing. The map shows each part's reading at the
-- Time Brush's instant. Every row stands at the model's origin (the complex's 70 m antenna).
SELECT g.dish || '.' || p.part AS part, g.time,
       g.name || ' · ' || coalesce(n.spacecraft, nullif(g.activity, ''), 'idle') AS name,
       g.state,
       CASE WHEN p.part = 'azimuth' THEN g.azimuth END AS model_yaw,
       CASE WHEN p.part = 'elevation' THEN g.elevation - 90 END AS model_pitch,
       round(g.down_bps / 1000, 1) AS downlink_kbps,
       round(g.range_km / 149597870.7, 4) AS distance_au,
       g.up_kw AS uplink_kw,
       g.azimuth, g.elevation,
       g.origin_latitude AS latitude, g.origin_longitude AS longitude
FROM grid g LEFT JOIN names n USING (targets), (VALUES ('azimuth'), ('elevation')) p(part)
WHERE g.site = 'cdscc'
ORDER BY part, g.time

grid AS (

              ELSE 'Pointing' END AS state
  FROM steps s CROSS JOIN 'http://feeds/datasets/dsn-antennas/dishes.parquet' d LEFT JOIN last l ON l.hex = d.dish AND l.time = s.time
)
-- A callout over each antenna: its spacecraft and the data coming down (kb/s) over the range, read at the
-- Time Brush's instant.
SELECT g.time, g.name || ' · ' || coalesce(n.spacecraft, 'idle') AS name,
       coalesce(round(g.down_bps / 1000, 1), 0) AS downlink_kbps,
       g.latitude, g.longitude,
       -- Over the dish's rim when it points at the zenith.
       CASE WHEN g.type = '70M' THEN 85 ELSE 45 END AS altitude
FROM grid g LEFT JOIN names n USING (targets)
WHERE g.site = 'cdscc'
ORDER BY g.dish, g.time

spec.description: Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex at Tidbinbilla: the 70 m DSS-43, the only antenna that can talk to Voyager 2, and the 34 m DSS-34, DSS-35 and DSS-36. Each antenna is NASA's model of a 34 m DSN antenna (a 70 m one at twice the size) turned to where it pointed at the Time Brush's instant (the end of its window; now, by default): its alidade to the azimuth and its dish down from the zenith to the elevation, as DSN Now said it then. Alidade and elevation wheel in the colour of what the antenna was doing (green two-way, blue receiving, orange transmitting, purple pointing with no signal, grey idle or in maintenance); over each, its spacecraft and the data coming down over the range, read at the instant. Play the Time Brush to watch them track and slew. Hover an antenna for its card.
spec.title: Canberra, Australia: Tidbinbilla

About the network and the data

options.content:
NASA's Deep Space Network (DSN) is how every mission beyond the Moon talks to Earth: fifteen large antennas at three complexes about 120° apart in longitude, at Goldstone in California, near Madrid in Spain and near Canberra in Australia, so that as Earth turns one of them always sees each spacecraft. JPL runs it for NASA; it also tracks other agencies' missions.

**On the maps** each antenna turns to where it pointed at the Time Brush's instant. DSN Now, the public feed behind NASA's own [DSN Now](https://eyes.nasa.gov/apps/dsn-now/dsn.html) page, gives every few seconds each antenna's azimuth and elevation, the spacecraft it talks to, the signals going up and coming down (data rate, band, power) and the round-trip light time, but keeps no history: Pacha's recorder reads it every 30 seconds and keeps a week, from the hour it first ran, and that recording is what the Time Brush moves through. Its window's end is the maps' instant: the antenna's alidade turns to the azimuth and its dish tilts down from the zenith to the elevation as they were then (Kepler Plus's 4D Model in State mode, its parts turned by model_yaw and model_pitch); play it to watch the antennas track their spacecraft across the sky and slew to the next. An antenna the feed leaves out is idle and stands pointing at the zenith. With a Kepler Plus older than its moving parts, every antenna stands that way. The cards at the top, the table and the light times are DSN Now as it is now.

**Reading it:** two-way (a signal up and down) is green, receiving only blue, transmitting only orange, pointing with no signal purple, idle or in maintenance grey. One antenna may serve several spacecraft at once (Multiple Spacecraft Per Aperture, around Mars); the light time is then left out of the cards and charts.

**Sources.** The feed: DSN Now (eyes.nasa.gov, NASA/JPL), read through Pacha's gateway, which keeps a copy 5 seconds. The antenna: [NASA's 3D model of a 34 m DSN antenna](https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/deep-space-network-34-meter/) (NASA 3D Resources, free to use under NASA's media guidelines; NASA does not endorse this dashboard), drawn at twice its size for the 70 m antennas. Where each antenna stands: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Satellite imagery: Google. Built by `datasets/dsn-antennas/build.sh`.

spec.rawSql:
-- Server side: the spacecraft in contact (a signal up or down) each minute, from the recording; the brush
-- draws the most in each of its bars. By the minute, so the brush's span ends at the newest reading.
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL 1 MINUTE, ts) AS time, count(DISTINCT u.code) AS "Spacecraft in contact"
FROM read_parquet([${files:singlequote}], union_by_name = true), unnest(string_split(targets, ',')) AS u(code)
WHERE ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND targets <> '' AND (up_kw IS NOT NULL OR down_bps IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.description: The spacecraft in contact (the most in each bar), as Pacha's recorder kept DSN Now (every 30 s, for a week, from the hour it first ran). The end of the window is the maps' instant: drag it, or play it, and every antenna turns to where it pointed then, in the colour of what it was doing, its callout reading the data coming down. The window follows the newest reading on each refresh unless you move it.
spec.title: The recording: pick an instant, or play it to watch the antennas turn

spec.rawSql:
-- DSN Now's feed through the gateway (/dsn/dsn.xml, kept 5 s): one XML file with a <dish> for each antenna
-- at work, where it points, and inside it a <target> for each spacecraft with its <upSignal>s and <downSignal>s.
WITH feed AS (
  SELECT r->>'body' AS xml FROM (SELECT http_get('http://feeds/dsn/dsn.xml') AS r) WHERE (r->>'status') = '200'
),
craft AS (
  -- The spacecraft's full names (JWST: James Webb Space Telescope), from DSN Now's configuration (kept a day).
  SELECT upper(regexp_extract(s, ' name="([^"]*)"', 1)) AS code, regexp_extract(s, 'friendlyName="([^"]*)"', 1) AS craft
  FROM (SELECT unnest(regexp_extract_all(r->>'body', '<spacecraft [^>]*>')) AS s
        FROM (SELECT http_get('http://feeds/dsn/config.xml') AS r) WHERE (r->>'status') = '200')
),
dish AS (
  SELECT x, regexp_extract(x, '<dish [^>]*>') AS tag
  FROM (SELECT unnest(regexp_extract_all(xml, '(?s)<dish [^>]*>.*?</dish>')) AS x FROM feed)
),
live AS (
  SELECT regexp_extract(tag, ' name="([^"]*)"', 1) AS dish,
         TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(tag, 'azimuthAngle="([^"]*)"', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS azimuth,
         TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(tag, 'elevationAngle="([^"]*)"', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS elevation,
         TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(tag, 'windSpeed="([^"]*)"', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS wind,
         regexp_extract(tag, 'activity="([^"]*)"', 1) AS activity,
         -- DSN and DSS are the network itself (tests, maintenance), not a spacecraft.
         list_filter(regexp_extract_all(x, '<target name="([^"]*)"', 1), t -> t NOT IN ('DSN', 'DSS', '')) AS targets,
         list_max(list_transform(regexp_extract_all(x, '<downSignal [^>]*active="true"[^>]*dataRate="([^"]*)"', 1),
                                 v -> TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE))) AS down_bps,
         list_max(list_transform(regexp_extract_all(x, '<upSignal [^>]*active="true"[^>]*power="([^"]*)"', 1),
                                 v -> TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE))) AS up_kw,
         nullif(regexp_extract(x, '<downSignal [^>]*active="true"[^>]*band="([^"]*)"', 1), '') AS band,
         list_max(list_transform(regexp_extract_all(x, '<target [^>]*downlegRange="([^"]*)"', 1),
                                 v -> TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE))) AS range_km,
         list_max(list_transform(regexp_extract_all(x, '<target [^>]*rtlt="([^"]*)"', 1),
                                 v -> TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE))) AS rtlt_s
  FROM dish
),
dishes AS (
  -- Every antenna, those the feed leaves out (idle) too, and what it is doing now.
  SELECT d.*, l.azimuth, l.elevation, l.wind, l.activity, coalesce(l.targets, []) AS targets,
         l.down_bps, l.up_kw, l.band,
         CASE WHEN l.range_km > 0 THEN l.range_km END AS range_km,
         CASE WHEN l.rtlt_s > 0 THEN l.rtlt_s END AS rtlt_s,
         CASE WHEN len(coalesce(l.targets, [])) = 0 THEN 'Idle or in maintenance'
              WHEN l.up_kw IS NOT NULL AND l.down_bps IS NOT NULL THEN 'Two-way'
              WHEN l.down_bps IS NOT NULL THEN 'Receiving'
              WHEN l.up_kw IS NOT NULL THEN 'Transmitting'
              ELSE 'Pointing' END AS state
  FROM 'http://feeds/datasets/dsn-antennas/dishes.parquet' d LEFT JOIN live l USING (dish)
),
names AS (
  SELECT dish, string_agg(coalesce(c.craft, t), ', ') AS spacecraft
  FROM (SELECT dish, unnest(targets) AS t FROM dishes) LEFT JOIN craft c ON c.code = t
  GROUP BY dish
)
-- Each spacecraft in contact and how long its signal takes to reach Earth (half its round trip).
SELECT coalesce(c.craft, t) AS "Spacecraft", max(rtlt_s) / 2 AS "Light time"
FROM (SELECT unnest(targets) AS t, rtlt_s FROM dishes WHERE rtlt_s IS NOT NULL AND len(targets) = 1) x
LEFT JOIN craft c ON c.code = t
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.description: Each spacecraft in contact and its one-way light time (half the round trip DSN Now gives), on a logarithmic scale: seconds from the Moon, minutes from the Sun's neighbourhood and the planets, hours from the Voyagers.
spec.title: How long each signal takes to reach Earth

spec.rawSql:
-- DSN Now's feed through the gateway (/dsn/dsn.xml, kept 5 s): one XML file with a <dish> for each antenna
-- at work, where it points, and inside it a <target> for each spacecraft with its <upSignal>s and <downSignal>s.
WITH feed AS (
  SELECT r->>'body' AS xml FROM (SELECT http_get('http://feeds/dsn/dsn.xml') AS r) WHERE (r->>'status') = '200'
),
craft AS (
  -- The spacecraft's full names (JWST: James Webb Space Telescope), from DSN Now's configuration (kept a day).
  SELECT upper(regexp_extract(s, ' name="([^"]*)"', 1)) AS code, regexp_extract(s, 'friendlyName="([^"]*)"', 1) AS craft
  FROM (SELECT unnest(regexp_extract_all(r->>'body', '<spacecraft [^>]*>')) AS s
        FROM (SELECT http_get('http://feeds/dsn/config.xml') AS r) WHERE (r->>'status') = '200')
),
dish AS (
  SELECT x, regexp_extract(x, '<dish [^>]*>') AS tag
  FROM (SELECT unnest(regexp_extract_all(xml, '(?s)<dish [^>]*>.*?</dish>')) AS x FROM feed)
),
live AS (
  SELECT regexp_extract(tag, ' name="([^"]*)"', 1) AS dish,
         TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(tag, 'azimuthAngle="([^"]*)"', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS azimuth,
         TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(tag, 'elevationAngle="([^"]*)"', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS elevation,
         TRY_CAST(regexp_extract(tag, 'windSpeed="([^"]*)"', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS wind,
         regexp_extract(tag, 'activity="([^"]*)"', 1) AS activity,
         -- DSN and DSS are the network itself (tests, maintenance), not a spacecraft.
         list_filter(regexp_extract_all(x, '<target name="([^"]*)"', 1), t -> t NOT IN ('DSN', 'DSS', '')) AS targets,
         list_max(list_transform(regexp_extract_all(x, '<downSignal [^>]*active="true"[^>]*dataRate="([^"]*)"', 1),
                                 v -> TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE))) AS down_bps,
         list_max(list_transform(regexp_extract_all(x, '<upSignal [^>]*active="true"[^>]*power="([^"]*)"', 1),
                                 v -> TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE))) AS up_kw,
         nullif(regexp_extract(x, '<downSignal [^>]*active="true"[^>]*band="([^"]*)"', 1), '') AS band,
         list_max(list_transform(regexp_extract_all(x, '<target [^>]*downlegRange="([^"]*)"', 1),
                                 v -> TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE))) AS range_km,
         list_max(list_transform(regexp_extract_all(x, '<target [^>]*rtlt="([^"]*)"', 1),
                                 v -> TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE))) AS rtlt_s
  FROM dish
),
dishes AS (
  -- Every antenna, those the feed leaves out (idle) too, and what it is doing now.
  SELECT d.*, l.azimuth, l.elevation, l.wind, l.activity, coalesce(l.targets, []) AS targets,
         l.down_bps, l.up_kw, l.band,
         CASE WHEN l.range_km > 0 THEN l.range_km END AS range_km,
         CASE WHEN l.rtlt_s > 0 THEN l.rtlt_s END AS rtlt_s,
         CASE WHEN len(coalesce(l.targets, [])) = 0 THEN 'Idle or in maintenance'
              WHEN l.up_kw IS NOT NULL AND l.down_bps IS NOT NULL THEN 'Two-way'
              WHEN l.down_bps IS NOT NULL THEN 'Receiving'
              WHEN l.up_kw IS NOT NULL THEN 'Transmitting'
              ELSE 'Pointing' END AS state
  FROM 'http://feeds/datasets/dsn-antennas/dishes.parquet' d LEFT JOIN live l USING (dish)
),
names AS (
  SELECT dish, string_agg(coalesce(c.craft, t), ', ') AS spacecraft
  FROM (SELECT dish, unnest(targets) AS t FROM dishes) LEFT JOIN craft c ON c.code = t
  GROUP BY dish
)
SELECT d.site_name AS "Complex", d.name AS "Antenna", d.diameter_m AS "Size",
       d.state AS "State", coalesce(n.spacecraft, '') AS "Spacecraft", coalesce(d.activity, 'Not in the feed') AS "Activity",
       round(d.down_bps / 1000, 1) AS "Down", d.up_kw AS "Up", d.band AS "Band",
       round(d.range_km / 149597870.7, 4) AS "Distance",
       CASE WHEN (d.rtlt_s / 2) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (d.rtlt_s / 2) < 60 THEN printf('%.1f s', (d.rtlt_s / 2)) WHEN (d.rtlt_s / 2) < 3600 THEN printf('%d min %02d s', ((d.rtlt_s / 2) // 60)::INT, ((d.rtlt_s / 2) % 60)::INT) ELSE printf('%d h %02d min', ((d.rtlt_s / 2) // 3600)::INT, (((d.rtlt_s / 2) % 3600) // 60)::INT) END AS "Light time",
       d.azimuth AS "Azimuth", d.elevation AS "Elevation", d.wind AS "Wind"
FROM dishes d LEFT JOIN names n USING (dish)
ORDER BY CASE d.state WHEN 'Idle or in maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, d.rtlt_s DESC NULLS LAST, d.dish

spec.description: The fifteen antennas, those at work first, farthest spacecraft first: what each is doing (DSN Now's activity), the spacecraft it talks to, the data coming down (kb/s, its fastest signal) and the power going up (kW), the band, the distance (astronomical units, from the downlink range) and the one-way light time, where it points (degrees: azimuth clockwise from north, elevation over the horizon) and the wind at the antenna (km/h).
spec.title: Every antenna now
NASA's Deep Space Network, live: where each antenna points and who it talks to

                          columns = {url: 'VARCHAR', "from": 'TIMESTAMPTZ', "to": 'TIMESTAMPTZ'})
WHERE "to" >= $__timeFrom() AND "from" <= $__timeTo()
UNION ALL SELECT 'http://feeds/datasets/dsn-antennas/recording-empty.parquet'
